messages:
Mina: Postmortem follow-up for Cerulean private deployment — two main issues: VPC peering instability under replicate-heavy bursts and a routing cleanup race causing transient tenant isolation. Need owners + deadlines so we can close loop with customer.
Ravi: I'll own peering hardening. Plan: audit BGP timers, add soft-restart behavior in edge, and add packet-loss injection tests. ETA 14 days. Will create tracker.
Sarah: Ill take connector resilience (agent restart/backoff + crash recovery e2e). Will add fault-injection job. ETA 8 business days.
Diego: Ill triage the routing cleanup race in tenant-routing. Likely a small CAS/state-machine fix. ETA 4 days.
Mina: Please paste ticket links here once created and add to Dedicated/Postmortem board. Also propose a weekly cadence to review recurring isolation patterns.
Ravi: Created INF-4219: peering stabilization + BGP guidance https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-4219
Sarah: Created INF-4220: connector restart/backoff + injection tests https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-4220
Diego: Created INF-4221: routing cleanup CAS fix + regression harness https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-4221
Mina: Condensed action items:
- Ravi (INF-4219): tune bgp hold-time, implement soft-restart, add flaky-network test
- Sarah (INF-4220): restart policy, exponential backoff config, CI fault-injection
- Diego (INF-4221): CAS on cleanup path, add racing cleanup integration
- Luke/Ops: add asymmetric-peering canary + Grafana panel
Luke: I'll wire the canary under infra/runbooks and a dashboard alert. ETA 2 business days.
Diego: Repro log snippet from local stress harness:
```
E 2025-03-12T14:23:11Z tenant-router: cleanup failed: key missing
W 2025-03-12T14:23:11Z requeue cleanup task
E 2025-03-12T14:23:11Z concurrent cleanup detected tenant=cerulean-42
```
Diego: Plan: guard cleanup with compare-and-swap and assert idempotency in integration test.
Sarah: Connector plan: add a feature flag for backoff, a smoke test that kills the agent container and verifies auto-rejoin < 30s, and document recommended private deploy defaults.
Ravi: Peering plan: recommend customer BGP timers, implement soft-restart in edge, and add a transient-loss test (100ms loss for 30s).
Mina: Org tasks: 1) add INF-4219/4220/4221 to Dedicated/Postmortem board, 2) start monthly "isolation rotation" where an eng-sre owns triage review. Sarah will draft roster by Friday.
Ops-bot: Reminder set for #incidents: weekly 09:00 UTC — "Isolation trends triage".
Laura: I'll add a replicate-heavy synthetic to the dedicated perf harness to reproduce the traffic spike. ETA 12 days (INF-4222).
Mina: Draft customer addendum for Cerulean (private): "We will deploy the routing-cleanup fix (INF-4221) within 5 business days. Connector resilience (INF-4220) and peering hardening (INF-4219) will follow per timelines. We'll coordinate a verification window with your infra team and share a changelog once merged."
Mina: Closing — please paste PRs and changelogs here as they land. Thanks everyone :tada:
